pattern: native-comparison-run: exit -11|native comparison global layout mismatch|Unknown command line argument.*bennett-layout-data-base
description:
Dialect @023f5a7 §19.5: "The link map gives A(F) for every function and the base of every global. The device layout (ISA §9.1) replicates it"; default data base is 4096 and "the defaults are options (--bennett-layout-data-base, --bennett-layout-text-base, §24)". On this host vm.mmap_min_addr=65536; loading a native ELF whose lookup table is at the plugin scalar object's G1 base=4096 cannot satisfy the ordinary native comparison at that layout. The required data-base option is rejected by plugin 157d4bd on LLVM18. Do not move just the native image, rewrite the source lookup, omit it, or claim a host crash is native equality. Fixed means implement the published comparison layout options end-to-end (all device global/heap/layout/hash addresses and native link map), and let the consumer select a host-mappable but identical device/native layout. No new program restriction.
Exact determining command (headless, TMPDIR conformance/.tmp, timeout 300):
/usr/lib/llvm-18/bin/opt -load-pass-plugin=/home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung1-bennett-plugin-157d4bd1fab98afed8579b2367f26d1d742b0173/build/libbennett-plugin-18.so -passes=bennett -bennett-dialect=0.2.10 -bennett-isa=0.8 -bennett-oracle=r1_lookup '-bennett-scalar-shape=IN(8,sext);tgt=8' --bennett-layout-data-base=65536 -bennett-out=/home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung1-layout-probe-out -disable-output /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung-1/20261101T132057.475661Z/C/18/r1_lookup/postlink.ll
Observed: opt: Unknown command line argument '--bennett-layout-data-base=65536'. Determining emitted global: G1 {base:4096,image:G1,size:8}; source instruction: load i8 from table[index & 7]. Probe output: .tmp/rung1-layout-probe.stderr. Corpus native comparison is attempted separately in the recorded real rung run; this issue does not claim a scalar pipeline refusal without the option.
